The finished version of Space Cadet Pinball for New 3DS: a camera that follows the ball, high scores with arcade-style initials, a touch menu, remappable controls, and a steady 60 fps.

**Download `SpaceCadetPinball.cia`** below and install it with FBI. Full setup steps, including where to put the game files, are in the [README](https://github.com/imphuochuynh/SpaceCadetPinball-3DS#how-to-install).

**Game files are not included.** You need the `CADET` folder from your own *Full Tilt! Pinball* disc.

`SpaceCadetPinball.3dsx` is the same game for the Homebrew Launcher, if you'd rather not install it.

Built with Claude (see the README's AI disclosure). Shared as is, with no support or updates planned.
